{
  "name": "migration-guard",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "Makes Claude ask before it touches your database migrations or runs destructive SQL, with the risk and what it found.",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/balen-abd/claude-migration-guard",
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": {
    "name": "Balen",
    "url": "https://x.com/balen_abda"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "migrations",
    "database",
    "postgres",
    "mysql",
    "prisma",
    "typeorm",
    "rails",
    "django",
    "supabase",
    "safety",
    "mod"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "When to ask",
      "description": "always: before every migration change. destructive-only: only when drops, truncates, type changes or risky commands (revert, reset, push, wipe...) show up. off: never ask (for a while, type /migration-guard off instead).",
      "default": "always",
      "options": [
        "always",
        "destructive-only",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "extraPathPattern": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extra migration path pattern",
      "description": "A regular expression for migration files the built-in rules miss, e.g. schema/changes/",
      "default": ""
    },
    "extraCommandPattern": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extra migration command pattern",
      "description": "A regular expression for migration commands the built-in rules miss, e.g. make db-up",
      "default": ""
    },
    "keepHistory": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Keep a history",
      "description": "on: remember each question and answer, shown by /migration-guard (kept by Claude Code, passwords masked). off: keep nothing.",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
